connector.name: seekrit - secrets for agents
connector.registryDescription: Encrypted store for API keys and database URLs your code needs. Use them without reading them.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.seekrit.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.seekrit. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Leave unset to connect anonymously — the tool list and instructions are public, and the `signup` tool mints your own credential. Once you have one: HTTP Basic, base64(clientId:clientSecret).
